name: Morse.covD
why: Both are P_{c(t)}(deriv X t). At c t in N, Morse.prj is the star projection onto Morse.tangentSubspace, which equals the blind span of velocities (tangentSpace_eq), so the projections coincide; at c t not in N, Morse.prj is 0 and the blind tangent space is bot (no curve in N passes through c t), so its projection is 0. Equal for all arguments, including the junk values (break points, c t outside N).
